Ok, so I played this once now and got a GW out of it, so that is fine.
Later on when someone else played it, an interesting question came up.
The timing of Summon Spirit together with dog pack.
There is no "before range" clause on Summon Spirit Beast, so there was
one game where the opposing vampire chose a combat ends strike, dragos
decides to hit with his mighty fists, then after choosing strikes, he
summons in a dog pack.

Does that mean that the chosen strike fizzles, like with aid from bats/
guns after playing immortal grapple?
